items.note: Lemon hero band with a 96px centred headline, a black CTA paired with a white bordered search at one shared height, and 5–6 thick ink-outlined objects cropped at the side edges and the bottom seam. The header has a black current pill, and the post grid has white ink-framed cards with band-colour vignettes. This is close to 01's composition. The stickers are smaller than the reference's coins, and a few run under the md size, so the ring around the headline weighs less than in 01.

The hero stacks the black CTA over a full-width bordered field at control height. Three or four thick stickers crop at the edges and the seam, and the band closes on a 1px ink seam into paper and full-width vignette cards. This keeps 09's stacked-band rhythm and the reference's drawing weight.

Faithful to 11: black ground, white current nav pill, a pink hero CTA, and the lemon band and stickers unchanged. Dark-grey cards hold the band-colour vignettes. In two samples the header's trailing action is a dark-grey hairline cell. In the reference it is a solid pink block in dark, so the header's end loses its anchor.

The phone hero keeps the lemon band and stickers. It inverts the CTA to pink with an ink outline and keeps the field white on the band, as the spec's on-band rule asks. Cards are dark-grey ink-framed panels with full-bleed vignettes. The language matches 11 carried onto a phone.

A compact lemon header band carries an underlined breadcrumb, a large title, meta and outlined tag pills, and closes on an ink seam, much like 06's band. Two samples set the table of contents as a white ruled ink box. The article figures are thick drawn vignettes on band grounds, and the page ends in related cards and a black footer (one sample adds a pink closing band). The craft is close to the reference.

The header band, the ruled table-of-contents box and the full-width figure vignettes hold up well on a phone. In two samples, though, the breadcrumb wraps to three lines and repeats the whole title above the title itself. The top of the band becomes cluttered, where 10's band stays tight.

The lemon band is unchanged on black. The table of contents and pull quote are dark-grey ink panels, and the figure vignettes keep their band grounds. The inversion follows 11 and the hierarchy matches light mode.

Same structure as light: lemon header band, dark ruled table-of-contents panel, band-ground figures, and dark ink-framed quote and code panels. It reads as one family with 11, and the band's seam into black stays visible.

Header band, ruled table of contents and thick vignette figures (clipboard, booklets, megaphone) are on reference. But this article's tall code block is a flat grey fill with a grey frame. It is the one surface outside the paper–white–ink triad, and it reads like stock markdown next to the white hairline panels of 07 and 08.

A compact lemon band (with the same wrapped breadcrumb seen on the other post), a white ruled contents box, then a single column of text with full-width band vignettes and ink-framed related cards. Rhythm and drawing are close to the reference's phone app screen (10).

Band, panels and vignettes invert correctly. Where no pink closing band sits above it, the black footer runs into the black body with no seam or rule. The page's end goes soft, whereas the reference closes every field with a visible edge.

The lemon band sits on black, the quote and code panels are dark grey with ink frames, and the vignettes keep their band colours. Long-form reading stays calm and drawn, as in the reference's dark appearance.

A periwinkle header band holds only a title and a one-line lead. Its trailing sticker is around 120–170px, and in one sample it is a thin notepad with little depth. The band is padded to the sticker's height, leaving 80–110px of empty colour; in one sample the title sits nearly flush to the top seam. Below it, a narrow text column and an authors list fill half the width. This is weaker than 06's compact, full band and more generic than the rest of the blog.

On a phone the periwinkle band fits its title and lead better, with the sticker cropped at the trailing edge. The authors sit in one white ruled ink box with monogram discs. It is recognisably the system but plain: the band carries no controls, and the body is plain text with no drawn or framed accent beyond the list.

Same layout as light: the periwinkle band on black still has the empty band colour under its lead and a small trailing sticker. The authors list is a dark-grey ruled panel. The inversion is correct, but the page inherits the light version's under-filled band and sparse body.

The periwinkle band with a cropped sticker, a dark ruled authors panel and the black footer with a white field and pink button. The inversion is consistent with 11, but the screen is as plain as the light version.

findings.summary: The About page's header band holds only a title and a one-line lead. It is stretched to the height of a small trailing sticker, which leaves 80–110px of empty band colour, and in one sample the title is jammed against the top seam. The reference's header band (06) is compact and full: the colour field carries title, breadcrumb, search and pill tabs, with even padding. Here the band reads as an empty colour slab, and the body below fills only half the width with plain text. This header-band gap, named in rc.3 and rc.4, is still open.
findings.promptFix: Header band sizing: equal block padding above and below the content (space.6–space.8). The band is as tall as its content plus that padding, never as tall as its sticker. Size the sticker to the band's content height and let it crop at the trailing edge, rather than growing the band to fit it. Below the last line of content, never leave more empty band colour than the band's own padding. A screen with no search or tabs of its own puts its breadcrumb or a short meta line in the band, never empty colour.
findings.specRule: Header band. One sticker, at least as tall as the title block plus lead (`size.stickerBand` on desktop, never under `size.stickerSm`)

findings.summary: Some hero stickers are small, about 110–130px at 1440 (below size.stickerMd), so the ring around the headline weighs less than 01's large coins. In some samples only two or three stickers reach lg size.
In dark mode the header's trailing action is a dark-grey hairline cell. In the reference (11) it is a solid pink block running the header's full height, which anchors the header's end.
On phones the post's breadcrumb wraps to three lines and repeats the full title just above the title itself, which clutters the top of the band. 10's band stays tight on one line.
Article code blocks are grey-filled boxes with grey borders. They are the only surfaces outside paper, white and ink, and they read like stock markdown next to the reference's white hairline panels.

In dark mode, wherever no pink closing band sits above it, the black footer runs into the black body with no seam or rule, so the page's last field has no edge. The reference closes every field with a visible line.
